Package

com.eqixiac.equinix.core.model
Core model interfaces and base types for the Equinix Java SDK.
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.optimizer
The Metro Optimization Engine: scores, ranks, and selects Equinix metros for a deployment from user sites, provider requirements, workloads, and constraints, against live Fabric catalog data.
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.optimizer.model
Immutable value types for the Metro Optimization Engine — the request side (sites, provider requirements, workload specs, constraints, scoring weights) and the result side (ranked recommendations, scores, topology, latency matrix, risk assessment, cost estimates).
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.peering
Peering Intelligence: interconnection analysis combining PeeringDB IX/facility data with the live Equinix Fabric catalog.
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.peering.model
Result value types for Peering Intelligence, all Lombok @Value (get-prefixed accessors) unless a hand-written accessor is documented.
